notes.title: Patch 1.2 Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Patch 1.2 

Bugs fixes:

[list]
[*] Pause duplication 
[*] Bin not saving on the level
[*] Streaks were not accurate 
[*] Can no longer move AI with Picked equipment
[*] Money duplication glitched 
[*] Customers taking the wrong food on the first order 
[*] Able to place equipment outside of the grid 
[*] Waiter taking wrong orders
[*] Added timer on interaction with till 
[*] fixed item duplication (Hopefully)
[/list]

Balance changes: 

[list]
[*] Increased customer waiting time 
[*] Cleaner movement increased 
[*] Waiter movement increased 
[*] increased money earned through streaks
[*] decreased staff costs and upkeep
[*] decreased store upkeep gain 
[*] 
[/list]


Current known bugs: 

Order UI bug where the orders won't show for clients and only host
Expeditor fails to interact leaving it confused and not doing its job (working on this now)
